Excels in long-range combat,
capable of striking wide areas with rapid fire. Boosting Sigil chance greatly increases trigger frequency.
Can charge at close range to deal massive DMG. Boosts critical rate for dealing massive DMG.
Excels in <color=#fcbe03>close-range</color> combat, using a <color=#fcbe03>Lance</color> as a weapon. Agile and fast, possessing excellent <color=#fcbe03>small area attack</color> capabilities.

Wields a <color=#fcbe03>Guardblade</color>, excelling in <color=#fcbe03>close-range combat</color>. Channels the power of Rock to form a protective shell, offering exceptional <color=#fcbe03>defense</color> and <color=#fcbe03>control</color>.
